description: This PHP source file defines the ExtensionManager class responsible for managing and compiling extension files in the SuiteCRM project. It includes methods for handling authentication, initializing module lists, compiling extension files for modules and applications, and managing file operations.

classes.name: ExtensionManager
classes.description: Manages the compilation and handling of extension files within SuiteCRM, including module and application extensions, with methods for file processing and security checks.

methods.name: handleAuth
methods.description: Checks if the script is accessed through a valid entry point, terminates execution if not.

methods.name: compileExtensionFiles
methods.description: Main method to compile extension files for a given extension, with options for filtering and application-only compilation.

methods.name: compileApplicationExtensions
methods.description: Compiles application extension files into a single PHP file.

methods.name: compileModuleExtensions
methods.description: Compiles module extension files for each module, including overrides.

methods.name: removePhpTagsFromString
methods.description: Removes PHP tags from a string of PHP code.

methods.name: shouldSkipFile
methods.description: Determines if a file should be skipped based on name, type, and filter.

methods.name: saveFile
methods.description: Saves compiled extension content to a file.

methods.name: unlinkFile
methods.description: Deletes a specified extension file if it exists.
